title: The Cost of Hedging in Trading
text: A hedge comes at a cost. It's not just reduce risk and enjoy more upside. There is a trade-off when we hedge. And it's an accepted trade-off. This is showing you what a collar is. What you'll see is we can add floor to this. We can add a floor by buying a put. But if you buy a put, for example, and you do not sell a call against it, there's a cost associated with that. You got to buy the put. And we know, especially in indices like this, puts are expensive. So then a lot of times people will sell a call against the put to try and finance some of it or all of it
